_readme: Canonical ground-truth workbook selection per project, overriding the fragile readdir-order pick. `truth`: single workbook. `merge`: genuine multi-workbook site split (block/street) to combine. `exclude`: unscoreable (unreadable format or ambiguous scope). Projects not listed auto-resolve to the richest non-empty candidate. See truth-facts.ts::resolveTruthFacts. Audited 2026-07 against entity counts + drawing match.
